[message_id=686691 author=AMITH NAIR first=True]
I am under the legal age in my jurisdiction, according to the competition rules, participants must be at least 18 years old or the age of majority in their jurisdiction. My parent/guardian has provided a consent form allowing me to participate in the competition. I would like to confirm in the event that I win a prize, can my parent/guardian legally sign the required prize acceptance forms on my behalf? Thank you for your guidance. I would like to kindly request a written confirmation from the competition sponsor or administrator regarding prize acceptance.
I want to ensure full compliance with all competition rules and legal requirements before participating.
Thank you in advance for your time and assistance.

[message_id=3432848 author=Addison Howard first=False]
Hi there,
In the event that a minor is a) permitted to enter by the host, b) has their parent/guardian out the appropriate forms (one for Kaggle.com and one for the specific competition), and c) wins a cash prize, then the parent will be allowed to accept the prize on behalf of the minor.
